messages:
Anna K.: Heads up — canary rollout 2026-03-19 (ui/console@b7f3c) is causing big stutters on the dashboard charts. Seeing repeated reflows when switching time ranges, and the metric panels freeze for ~600-900ms. :eyes:
Matt P.: Yikes. Did you grab a flame/profile?
Anna K.: Yep — attached perf snapshot in the canary. Main blockers look like a bunch of main-thread JS from a new auto-resize utility that iterates DOM children on every window resize and route change. Also noticed larger main bundle after the deploy.
Sarai L.: Which bundle? Any new vendor inlined?
Anna K.: It appears the chart split changed – we accidentally removed the dynamic import for the autosizer so bundler pulled in the full charting polyfill. Build trace: `ui/console/components/ChartPanel -> autosize.js (was dynamic) -> chart-polyfills`.
Kevin G.: That explains heap spikes. Telemetry shows a CPU spike and JS heap bump around the same ts. Also we see a lot of KV-cache misses for heatmap tiles right after switching ranges — could be invalidation happening on each resize.
Matt P.: Can you paste the telemetry snippet?
Anna K.: From metrics-service: `console.renderer.fp +430ms, console.renderer.longtask_count +3, js_heap_bytes_used +35MB` for canary instances. Also saw many `prefetch:tile` HTTP calls repeat for identical ranges.
Sarai L.: Prefetch was supposed to be debounced by route params. Maybe the autosize change triggers layout thrash and resets the debounce key.
Kevin G.: Repro steps I used: open dashboard, pick 24h -> toggle comparisons -> scroll. Each interaction causes prefetch and full re-render of sparklines. Can confirm on Chromium and macOS.
Matt P.: Quick mitigation: revert autosize import to dynamic or gate it on `isVisible`. Anna can you try a hotfix to lazy-load autosize and debounce prefetch to 250ms?
Anna K.: I'll push a canary hotfix to only import autosize inside a `useEffect` and add a simple debounce wrapper for prefetch. PR: #5123.
DeployBot: deploy started for app=console env=canary by Anna K. (PR #5123)
Sarai L.: Beyond hotfix, we should add a CI perf check for main bundle size and a lint rule preventing accidental static imports of large chart libs. We keep hitting regressions from churn in chart split rules.
Matt P.: Agreed. Also let's add a telemetry alarm for repeated identical prefetches — threshold 5/min per session. That would catch the debounce regressions before canary reaches stable.
Kevin G.: Filed infra ticket to add a prefetch dedupe metric and a canary guard: `telemetry.prefetch.duplicates > 10` -> block promo.
Anna K.: Hotfix deployed to canary, initial smoke is better — longtask_count down to +1 and FP delta ~+50ms. Leaving canary for 30m and then promoting if stable.
Matt P.: Great. After promote we should still follow up with: 1) add bundle-size CI gate, 2) fix chart KV-cache invalidation (looks like we clear on resize), 3) add debounce/dedupe for prefetch and 4) postmortem note in eng-platform.
Sarai L.: I'll draft the postmortem and strip down the autosize API so it's side-effect free.
Anna K.: Thanks all. I'll monitor canary and paste final telemetry. :thumbsup:
